definition: a small handheld device to call and text
description: A rocky mountain summit under a deep blue sky. A young woman in a yellow jacket, black trousers and hiking boots climbs onto a boulder, stretches up and holds a mobile phone high in the air, first with one hand and then with both, her ponytail blowing sideways. A young man sits on the rocks below, laughing and eating a sandwich. A stone cairn, a backpack, trekking poles and a paper map lie on the rocks, two black birds fly past and hazy ridges stretch to the horizon.
